query: What learner needs and pain points appear in survey responses?

per_column.name: instructional_format
per_column.rationale: Gives a genuine axis to segment pain points by delivery mode. Values are mostly grounded (recorded lectures -> flipped_async_video, kitchen-chemistry -> project_based). Some rows lack explicit format cues (ED-0003 has no clear live-vs-async signal), so a few 'live_interactive' assignments are mild inferences, but they are reasonable readings.

per_column.name: teacher_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant to learner pain points. Grounded where text is explicit (ED-0003 'teacher can't tell' -> absent_or_unresponsive). Weaker where silent: ED-0002 'highly_responsive' and ED-0004 'highly_responsive' are inferred from general positivity rather than stated responsiveness, and ED-0005 'adequate' is a soft read. Some confident specifics on silent rows.

per_column.name: engagement_level
per_column.rationale: Central to the query; strong axis for comparison. Values track the text well (ED-0005 cameras off -> disengaged, ED-0002 show up on time -> actively_engaged, ED-0004 self-paced note-taking -> actively_engaged). Well grounded.

per_column.name: peer_interaction_loss
per_column.rationale: Captures a distinct, recurring pain point (social/community loss). Grounded: ED-0003 'zero peer interaction' -> severe_loss, ED-0005 silent chat -> severe_loss. ED-0001 'moderate_loss' is a lighter inference from 'raise my hand quietly' but defensible.

per_column.name: handson_gap_type
per_column.rationale: Typed hands-on gaps are a real, subject-specific need axis. Mostly 'not_present' correctly for rows with no lab/studio content, and ED-0002 labs-over-video -> lab_experiment_gap is well grounded. Appropriate 'not_present' for silent rows is correct behaviour.

per_column.name: positive_adaptation
per_column.rationale: Adds a useful counter-axis (what works) complementing pain points. Grounded: ED-0002 creative labs -> innovative_curriculum_design, ED-0004 documentary clips -> effective_digital_tool_use. 'not_present' used sensibly for rows lacking positives.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively provide multiple genuine, non-redundant analytical axes (format, responsiveness, engagement, peer loss, hands-on gaps, positive adaptations) that map directly onto the query about learner needs and pain points. None are near-constant or trivial restatements. Values are generally sound readings of the source text, with appropriate 'not_present' defaults for silent rows. The main groundedness weakness is teacher_responsiveness and some instructional_format assignments, where the system occasionally infers confident specifics on rows that are silent about those attributes; this is mild rather than fabricated fact.
